title: openttd-prismatic-bridge /decision/pull contract
description: The machine-checkable contract for the bridge's POST /decision/pull endpoint (ARCHITECTURE.md §4, §7). The endpoint GETs a decision directive from PRISMATIC_DECISION_URL (a prismatic-platform route this repository does not assume), applies it to a running OpenTTD company via the Admin Network (reload_ai when company_id is present, else start_ai when ai is present), and returns a DecisionPullResult. 'request' is the directive prismatic-platform must produce; 'response' is what the bridge returns. The bridge reads only the three documented directive fields; the admin-client language (I0012 / ADR 0032) does not change this HTTP contract.

request.description: The decision directive prismatic-platform returns from PRISMATIC_DECISION_URL.

response.description: The DecisionPullResult the bridge returns from POST /decision/pull.

decisionDirective.description: What PRISMATIC_DECISION_URL returns. At least one of 'ai' or 'company_id' must be present, or the bridge applies nothing. When 'company_id' is present the bridge issues 'reload_ai <company_id>' (the company keeps its configured settings); otherwise, when 'ai' is present, it issues 'start_ai <ai> [settings]'. Only these three fields are read. A directive may carry its own working beside them (prismatic_api answers 'engine', 'chosen_aggressiveness', 'candidates', 'expected_value', 'iterations_per_candidate', 'company_input'); consumers do not read it, and the MCP panel names it in its answer.

ai.description: AI short name as registered with OpenTTD, e.g. 'PrismaticAI'. Used by start_ai when company_id is absent.

company_id.description: Zero-based OpenTTD company id (0..14; OpenTTD allows at most 15 companies). When present, the bridge reloads that company's AI with reload_ai.

settings.description: AI settings string as accepted by the console's start_ai command: a comma-separated list of key=value pairs, no spaces. Applied on start_ai; on reload_ai the company's stored settings are used instead.

decisionPullResult.description: The bridge's response: the URL it called, the raw directive it received, and the rcon result of applying it (null when nothing was applied).

raw_response.description: The decision directive the bridge received from called_url, echoed verbatim.

applied_rcon.description: The console (rcon) output of the reload_ai/start_ai command the directive triggered, or null when neither field was present so nothing was applied.

rconResponse.description: An OpenTTD console command's output lines (start_ai/reload_ai usually return an empty list on success).

lines.description: One entry per console output line.
